editingNote: Editing an existing record. Every field is loaded from what was saved.

description.tp: Institutions and organisations contributing to the delivery of the training programme.
description.pp: Partners supporting local producers with advisory services, processing, finance and market access.
description.tc: One record per participant per training, carrying the completion decision that counts towards A1.3.
description.ln: Each profile joins one farmer from the completion records to one production-support partner.
description.ex: Municipal markets and exhibitions organised under the Action Plan. Only events already held count towards E0.1.
description.rg: Producer registrations per event. Registrations from the producer portal wait for municipality approval.
description.fu: Follow-up interviews at six and twelve months. Forty-three questions across six sections.
description.os: One record per visit to the coordination office. B1.2 counts distinct people, not visits — the same farmer coming six times is one person and six records.
description.gd: One record per session of guidance on food safety, licensing, packaging and related requirements. D0.1 counts distinct producers, not sessions — the same producer helped three times is one producer and three records.
description.pn: Every organisation the Municipality works with, listed once. An organisation may hold a training agreement, a production-support agreement, or both — the type is a field on the form, not a separate list.

empty.title: No records yet
empty.desc: {name} has no records. Add the first one and it starts feeding {indicators}.
empty.filteredDesc: No record in {name} matches the current search and filter. Clear them to see all {total}.

validation.nidDigitsOnly: Numbers only — no spaces, letters or dashes.
validation.nidLength: A national ID is exactly 9 digits. This has {count}.
validation.nidMismatch: The two national ID fields do not match.

partner.name: Name of partner
partner.namePh: Full registered name of the institution
partner.typeHelp: Choose “Other” only when none of the categories applies.
partner.roleTraining: Primary role in the training programme
partner.roleProduction: Primary role in supporting local producers
partner.roleHelpTraining: At least one role is needed for the partnership to count towards A1.2.
partner.roleHelpProduction: At least one role is needed for the partnership to count towards C1.1.
partner.unitHelp: Optional. Two units of one university are two partners — the name and the unit together are what make an organisation unique.
partner.oneOrganisation: One organisation, one record. If this body is already on file under the same name and unit, saving updates it rather than creating a second one.
partner.agreementNote: Which kind of partnership this is. A1.2 counts training partnerships and C1.1 counts production-support ones, so this choice decides which indicator the record feeds.
partner.partnershipTypeHelp: To give an organisation the other kind as well, open it again and choose the other type. It keeps one record.
partner.establishedHelp: The date it was agreed, not the date you are entering it. A1.2 and C1.1 count partnerships established inside the reporting period, so this decides which quarter it lands in.
partner.establishedRequired: Give the date the agreement was established.
partner.chooseTypeFirst: Choose a partnership type above. The partner types and roles are different lists for each, so there is nothing to offer until then.
partner.agreementsBody: One block per partnership. The type is what separates A1.2 from C1.1, so each block names the indicator it feeds.
partner.noAgreements: This organisation holds no live agreement, so it feeds no indicator yet.
partner.deleteAgreementWarn: {code} drops by one. The organisation and its other agreement stay.
partner.addOtherType: To add the other kind of agreement to this organisation, edit it and choose the other partnership type — it keeps one record.

completion.name: Name
completion.dobHelp: Ask if they know it. Without it they can never look up their own applications on the public website — the site checks national ID plus date of birth, and falls back to a phone number only when there is no date of birth on file.
completion.ageHelp: Only needed when the date of birth is not known. One of the two is required.
completion.phoneHelp: Optional, but it is the only way someone with no date of birth can be found by the public website.
completion.decisionNote: This one answer decides whether the participant is counted. Only “Yes” adds to the 120-person target.
completion.metCriteria: Did this person meet the completion criteria?
completion.sessionHelp: Pick the session this person attended. Sessions covering the date you entered are listed first.
completion.sessionHelpNone: No session on this topic matches that date. Choosing to create one records the completion and leaves the session details to be filled in later.
completion.createNewSession: None of these — create a new session
completion.willCreateSession: A new session will be created with just the title, topic and dates. It will show as needing details, and will not count towards D0.2 until someone records that it was delivered.

linkage.farmerNote: A linkage profile can only exist for someone already in the Training Completion form. Choosing a farmer fills the name and phone from that record.
linkage.farmerHelp: Only people recorded in the Training Completion form appear here.
linkage.notMetWarning: This person did not meet the training completion criteria. Production support normally requires a completed training.
linkage.name: Name
linkage.partnerHelp: {count, plural, one {# partner is} other {# partners are}} currently registered in that form.
linkage.scopePh: What the partner and the farmer will do together
linkage.requestPh: What the farmer is asking the partner for

exhibition.name: Exhibition or market name
exhibition.publicNote: These appear on the public site once this market is published. Publishing is a separate step. The contact is shown exactly as typed, so use an office contact rather than a personal mobile.

registration.exhibitionHelp: Events already held or fully booked cannot be selected.
registration.existingHelp: Existing producer — will not be double counted in E0.2.
registration.newHelp: New producer. This national ID is not yet in the system.
registration.lookupHelp: Typing a known national ID fills the name and phone automatically.
registration.producerType: What type of producer are you?
registration.firstTime: Is this your first municipal market or exhibition?
registration.awaitingApproval: This registration came from the producer portal and is waiting for a decision.

deleteNote.tp: A1.2 and G0.4 drop by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.pp: C1.1 and G0.4 drop by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.ln: C1.2 drops by one immediately. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.ex: E0.1 drops by one if the event had already been held. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.tc: A1.3 and D0.1 are recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.rg: E0.2 is recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.fu: A1, B1, C1 and IMP-0 are recalculated in the next quarterly return. This cannot be undone.
deleteNote.os: B1.2 counts distinct people reaching office services. Removing this visit only changes the figure if it was that person’s only one.
deleteNote.gd: D0.1 counts distinct producers receiving guidance. Removing this record only changes the figure if it was that producer’s only one.
deleteNote.pn: This removes the ORGANISATION and every agreement it holds. A1.2, C1.1 and G0.4 all drop, including in quarters already reported. To remove one agreement and keep the other, use the partnerships panel instead.

session.listIntro: Publish a session to open it for applications, and decide who took part.
session.loadFailed: Could not load this. Check your connection and try again.
session.publishedBody: This session is on the public site now. Anyone can see it and apply.
session.notPublishedBody: This session is not on the public site. Nobody outside the Municipality can see it.
session.publicDates: The dates and the closing date for applications
session.publicFocalPoint: The contact you typed — this is shown to the public exactly as written, so use an office contact, not a personal number.
session.publicNever: Never public: applicant names, national IDs, or how many people have applied.
session.deliveryBody: Recording delivery says the session actually took place. It is counted in indicator D0.2. It is not the same as publishing, and it does not change what the public sees.
session.deliveryNotEnded: This session has not ended yet, so it cannot be recorded as delivered.
session.deliveryRefused: The database refused this. A session cannot be recorded as delivered before it has ended.
session.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing awaiting review} one {# awaiting review} other {# awaiting review}}
session.threeFactsNote: Accepted, attended and completed are three separate facts. Only completed counts towards indicator A1.3 and unlocks advisory.
session.deleteImpactEnrolments: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is enrolled on this session.} one {# person is enrolled on this session.} other {# people are enrolled on this session.}}
session.deleteImpactEligibility: {count, plural, one {# person would lose access to advisory, because this is the only training they have completed.} other {# people would lose access to advisory, because this is the only training they have completed.}}
session.deleteImpactKeepAdvisory: {count, plural, one {# of them already has an advisory place, which they keep.} other {# of them already have advisory places, which they keep.}}
session.deleteImpactNone: Nobody would lose access to advisory.
session.needsDetailsBody: This session cannot be published until these are filled in. The public page needs them to be worth reading.
session.needsDetailsFromCompletion: This session was created automatically when someone recorded a completion for a course that was not set up in the system. It has a title, a subject and dates, and nothing else. Fill in the rest before publishing it, or leave it as an internal record.
session.endedNoPublish: This session has already ended, so it cannot be published. The public site only lists what is still to come — publishing it would change nothing anyone could see.
session.listIntroAdvisory: Advisory is for people who have completed a training. Each session is on one of two tracks — market, or home-based production. Publish a session to open it for applications.
session.qualPlusMore: {count, plural, one {and # other completed training} other {and # other completed trainings}}
session.deliveryBodyAdvisory: Recording delivery says the session actually took place. Unlike a training, this does not feed any indicator — advisory has none of its own, and C1.3 is an open question that is deliberately not wired to it. It is recorded so the programme has an honest account of what was delivered.
session.deliveryNotEndedAdvisory: This session has not ended yet, so it cannot be recorded as delivered.
session.threeFactsNoteAdvisory: Accepted, attended and completed are three separate facts. Completing a session on the MARKET track unlocks a market linkage request; the home-based track does not. Unlike a training, completing an advisory does not move any indicator.
session.publishedBodyAdvisory: This session is on the public site now. People who have completed a training can see it and apply.
session.notPublishedBodyAdvisory: This session is not on the public site. Nobody outside the Municipality can see it.
session.endedNoPublishAdvisory: This session has already ended, so it cannot be published. The public site only lists what is still to come — publishing it would change nothing anyone could see.

newSession.heading: New training session
newSession.intro: Creating a session does not publish it. You publish it as a separate step, once the details are right.
newSession.title: Title
newSession.sectorHint: The subject area. Shown to the public as the sector.
newSession.hoursHint: How many hours of teaching. Not the number of days — a three-day course may be twelve hours.
newSession.venueHint: Where people should go. Shown publicly.
newSession.partnerHint: Optional. Leave empty if the Municipality ran this alone.
newSession.seatsHint: Optional. Set it and the public page shows places remaining; leave it and the page shows the closing date. The number of applicants is never shown publicly.
newSession.publicHeading: This goes on the public page
newSession.publicBody: Anyone can read this, including people outside the Municipality. Use an office contact rather than a personal mobile number.
newSession.warnEndBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date. Saving will be refused until this is corrected.
newSession.warnClosesAfterStart: Applications close after the training starts. That is allowed and sometimes intended, but check it is what you meant.
newSession.warnWindowPast: The application window has already closed. The session can still be created — useful for recording something historic — but nobody will be able to apply to it.
newSession.warnNoPartners: There are no training partnerships yet, so there is nothing to choose. You can leave the partner empty, or create one first:
newSession.saveFailed: Could not save this session. Check your connection and try again.
newSession.notPublishedYet: Once created, the session is a draft. It is not on the public site until you publish it from the session page.
newSession.trackHint: One form serves both. The choice decides whether completing this session lets a producer ask to be connected to a buyer.

trackNote.market: Completing a session on this track is what lets a producer ask the Municipality to connect them to a buyer.
trackNote.home_based: Food safety, licensing and packaging for home-based production. Completing this does NOT open a market linkage request.

exhibitionAdmin.loadFailed: Could not load this market. Check your connection and try again.
exhibitionAdmin.atCapacity: Every booth is taken. The database will refuse another approval until one is withdrawn.
exhibitionAdmin.publishedBody: This market is on the public site now. Anyone can see it and apply for a booth.
exhibitionAdmin.notPublishedBody: This market is not on the public site. Nobody outside the Municipality can see it.
exhibitionAdmin.endedNoPublish: This market has already ended, so it cannot be published. The public site only lists what is still to come — publishing it would change nothing anyone could see. It still counts towards E0.1, which does not depend on publication.
exhibitionAdmin.cannotPublishYet: It cannot be published until these are filled in:
exhibitionAdmin.pendingCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing awaiting review} one {# awaiting review} other {# awaiting review}}
exhibitionAdmin.approvalNote: Approving is what counts. Indicator E0.2 counts distinct producers with an approved registration — a registration awaiting review counts for nothing, and approving the same producer on a second market does not count them twice.
exhibitionAdmin.decisionRefused: The database refused that. Approving is a coordinator's decision, and it is refused once every booth is taken or after the market has ended.

linkageAdmin.queueIntro: Producers who finished an advisory session on the market track and asked to be connected to a buyer, a processor, a supplier or a market.
linkageAdmin.openCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing awaiting review} one {# awaiting review} other {# awaiting review}}
linkageAdmin.emptyBody: Nobody has asked to be connected. A request can only be made by someone who has completed an advisory session on the market track.
linkageAdmin.loadFailed: Check your connection and try again.
linkageAdmin.queueNote: Matching a request creates a production initiative and a market linkage together. The linkage starts as proposed. Indicator C1.2 counts initiatives whose linkage is active or ended, so it does not move until the linkage does.
linkageAdmin.notFoundBody: This request does not exist, or it has been withdrawn.
linkageAdmin.otherRequests: {count, plural, one {This person has # other request} other {This person has # other requests}}
linkageAdmin.advanceExplain: Move the linkage on as the relationship becomes real. Proposed and under review are an introduction. Active means they are actually trading, and that is what indicator C1.2 counts.
linkageAdmin.whichInitiative: Which initiative does this linkage belong to?
linkageAdmin.noInitiativeYet: This person has no initiative yet, so matching will create one from what they told us on the request.
linkageAdmin.attachExplain: Attach it to what they already run wherever you can. A linkage is a new connection for an existing venture more often than it is a new venture.
linkageAdmin.createNewConsequence: This counts as a second initiative in C1.2. Choose it only if this really is a different venture, not another connection for the one above.
linkageAdmin.partnerHint: Who the producer is being connected to.
linkageAdmin.scopeHint: One line — for example, supply preserves to processor.
linkageAdmin.proposedExplain: Matching creates the linkage as proposed, and C1.2 counts only active and ended linkages — so this will not move the indicator today.

refused.not_found: That request no longer exists. It may have been withdrawn while this page was open.
refused.already_matched: This request has already been matched, possibly by someone else just now. Reload the page to see the match.
refused.is_closed: This request is closed. Reopen it before matching it.
refused.scope_required: Say what the linkage covers before matching.
refused.partnership_not_found: That partnership no longer exists. Choose another.
refused.initiative_not_theirs: That initiative belongs to a different producer, so the linkage cannot be attached to it.
refused.needs_initiative_choice: This producer already has an initiative. The database will not create a second one unless it is asked to in so many words, because a second initiative moves C1.2 permanently. Choose the initiative to attach to, or choose a new one deliberately.
refused.not_permitted: Matching a request is a coordinator's decision, and your account does not have that role. The request is still here — ask a coordinator to match it.

linkageAdmin.matchFailed: The match could not be saved. Nothing was written.
linkageAdmin.closeBody: Closing records that this request will not be matched. It is not a deletion — the request stays on file, and someone asking why they never heard back can be answered.
linkageAdmin.closedReason: Why it will not be matched
linkageAdmin.closedReasonHint: In your own words. For example: no processor in the governorate takes this volume; producer withdrew; could not reach them after three calls.
linkageAdmin.closedNote: This request was closed without a match. It can be reopened if something changes.
linkageAdmin.toastMatchedNew: Matched, and a new initiative was created
linkageAdmin.toastProposed: The linkage starts as proposed, so C1.2 has not moved.
linkageAdmin.approveIsMatch: Approving this request and choosing a partner are the same act. A linkage always names who the producer was connected to, so there is no way to approve one without saying who — and nothing else on this screen approves it.

office.whoNote: We have no record of this national ID. Filling this in will create a new person record.
office.returning: This person is already on file. Their details are shown as recorded and are not edited here — B1.2 counts them once however many times they come.
office.nidHelp: Ask for the card. B1.2 counts distinct people, so the national ID is what keeps a returning visitor from being counted as a new one.
office.name: Full name
office.adviserHelp: Who in the office dealt with it.

notConnectedBody: This screen is not wired to the database yet. Anything entered here is not saved and does not reach {list}. The records listed are sample data, not real participants.
notConnectedFoot: Saving is disabled until this screen is connected.

linkageDirect.title: Record a linkage
linkageDirect.intro: For a linkage the Municipality made in person — a buyer mentioned at a meeting, an introduction at a market. It creates the same records a matched request does.
linkageDirect.noGateNote: A public linkage request requires a completed advisory, because that gate is about who may ask. This screen has no such condition: it records something that already happened, and refusing to write it down would lose real programme activity.
linkageDirect.nationalIdHint: Nine digits. The producer must already be on file.
linkageDirect.notFound: No producer on file with that national ID. Check the number, or record their first activity before linking them.
linkageDirect.noteHint: How the connection came about. Optional.

refused.person_not_found: No producer on file with that national ID.
refused.bad_national_id: A national ID is exactly nine digits.
refused.initiative_details_required: A new initiative needs a title and an activity type.

guidance.whoNote: We have no record of this national ID. Filling this in will create a new person record.
guidance.returning: This producer is already on file. Their details are shown as recorded and are not edited here — D0.1 counts them once however many times they are helped.
guidance.nidHelp: Ask for the card. D0.1 counts distinct producers, so the national ID is what keeps a returning producer from being counted as a new one.
guidance.name: Full name
guidance.deliveredByHelp: The officer or partner who gave the guidance.

initiative.listIntro: Small-scale and family-based production activities supported under the Action Plan. Mentorship sessions are recorded on the initiative they were delivered to.
initiative.loadFailed: The initiatives could not be loaded.
initiative.none: No initiatives yet. One is created when a linkage request is matched, or when a linkage is recorded directly.
initiative.mentorshipBody: Every session recorded here adds one to C1.3. Unlike the coordination office and the guidance log, this counts sessions and not people — three sessions with the same producer are three.
initiative.noSessions: No mentorship sessions recorded for this initiative yet.
initiative.topicPh: e.g. Costing and pricing the product
initiative.deleteWarn: C1.3 drops by one. This cannot be undone.

contribution.heading: Contributions this partner has made
contribution.body: G0.4 counts partners with at least one documented contribution inside the reporting period, and it resets every quarter. A partner with an agreement and no activity this quarter does not count, and a second contribution from the same partner in the same quarter moves nothing.
contribution.none: No contributions recorded for this partner.

from.coordination_meeting: From this partner’s attendance at a coordination meeting. Withdraw the meeting to withdraw the credit.
from.market_linkage: From a market linkage that is active or ended. Take the linkage back to proposed to withdraw the credit.
from.training_session: From a training session marked delivered. Un-mark delivery to withdraw the credit.

contribution.addNote: Only for what nothing else records. Coordination meetings, market linkages and delivered training sessions already write their own contribution — entering one of those by hand would count the partner twice in the log, though not twice in G0.4.
contribution.dateHelp: This decides which quarter it counts in — the date it happened, not the date it was entered.
contribution.descriptionPh: e.g. Donated seedlings to four households
contribution.deleteWarn: G0.4 drops by one if this was the partner’s only contribution this quarter.
contribution.partnershipRequired: Choose which agreement this was made under.
contribution.noAgreement: This organisation holds no live agreement. A contribution is always made under one, so there is nowhere to record this until it has one.
